scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.config.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tooling/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.check.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:desktop && npm run test:typescript:built && npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop:built
scripts.test:typescript: npm run build:desktop && npm run test:typescript:built
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build:desktop && npm run test:typescript:built && npm run test:web -- --require-assets && npm run test:desktop:built && npm run probe:runtime && npm run audit:typescript && npm run audit:publication
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && tsc -b apps/desktop && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.config.json && esbuild apps/desktop/src/preload.cts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=apps/desktop/dist/preload.cjs && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run test:desktop:built
scripts.package:desktop: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:icon && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --config dist-config/electron-builder.cjs --publish never
